'''Deep Cross Gaming''' is a [[:category:Taiwan|Taiwanese]] esports organisation formed in January 2022. They are currently playing as '''Relove Deep Cross Gaming''' due to the sponsorship of [https://www.foreverrelove.com.tw Relove].
